verdict.rationale: Discord's API supports OAuth2 bearer tokens with defined scopes and bot tokens with granular permission bits (docs-4, docs-6, docs-17, docs-18, docs-27), which technically allow issuing narrower-than-full-access credentials for any integration, including an agent.
